title: decree upgrade --format json
description: What `decree upgrade --format json` prints on stdout: how to upgrade decree. decree runs none of it and makes no network call; the person runs the lines. Reference: docs/reference/cli.md, Upgrading decree.

version.description: The version of the decree running, as `decree --version` prints it without the name.

install.description: The install line of the README, which installs the newest release.

pinned.description: The install line pinned to a release: `| sh -s -- <tag>`, with `<tag>` standing for the release tag.

cargo.description: For a copy installed with `cargo install`, which the install line does not replace: `cargo install --git <repository> --tag <tag> --force`.

cargo_note.description: That when `which -a decree` lists two copies, the one first on PATH runs, so the other is removed (`cargo uninstall decree`).

releases.description: The page that lists the release tags.

after.description: What to run in each project after upgrading, in order.

when.description: When it is needed; absent when always.

examples.cargo_note: If `which -a decree` lists two copies, the one first on PATH runs, so remove the other (`cargo uninstall decree`).
